newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close down on investor anxiety.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close down on investor anxiety.

text.p: * Foreign selling, Senate changes dampen sentiment
Philippine shares closed weaker on Friday as foreign selling was compounded by uncertainty over leadership changes in the Senate, brokers said.
"Its still emotion-driven, people are scared but there is a slowdown compared to previous days," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
The main index dropped at the close of trade on Friday by 28.76 points, or 0.96 percent, to 2,973.59 points.
The Senate changes, in which a new leader was chosen, had added to the selling pressure causing other blue chips to fall, said Spencer Yap at BPI Capital.
But Reyes said a technical recovery may have started as some blue chips such as Metro Pacific Corp gained, rising by 20 centavos to 6.30 pesos a share.
Gainers outpaced losers 65 to 42 with 72 issues unchanged.

"We are nearing the bottom and we see a dramatic technical rebound by next week as third quarter corporate results come in," said Jonas Ferrer, research director at Pryce Securities Inc. - KATHERINE ESPINA 63 2 841-8937 Fax 8176267
